lines: Delusion — suffering-thick, surmise-piled reasoning, error-chains swarming from ever-rising causes, mirage-town-like —
unshining in consciousness-sky, ground of dual-nor-nondual thought-rest: where else could the highest stand stay, even for the many-selfed?
sanskrit_cite: moho duḥkhavitarkatarkaṇaghano hetuprathānantaraprodyadvibhramaśṛṅkhalātibahulo gandharvapūḥsannibhaḥ | dvaitādvaitavikalpanāśrayapade cidvyomni nābhāti cet | kutrānyatra cakāstu kāstu paramā niṣṭhāpy anekātmanām

lines: Dream's road is the unreal after all; display in deep-sleep's house —
past that, in conditionless consciousness-sky, what grasp is his? If waking's heap stood earth-firm even a moment somewhere, then by knowing past that, this apart — what refutation even there?
sanskrit_cite: svapne tāvad asatyam eva saraṇaṃ sausuptadhāmni prathā | naivāsyāsti taduttare nirupadhau cidvyomni ko 'sya grahaḥ | jāgraty eva dharāvad arthanicayaḥ syāc cet kṣaṇe kutracij | jñānenātha tadatyaye pṛthag idaṃ tatrāpi kā khaṇḍanā

lines: Whatever lights abide in me, in highest heaven room-found, shine in me eternal-famed, unparted — I am He:
unfeigned, eternal, unbroken-ruled, boundless, true, free, dispelling the foe-pair's dark, nondual-not, beginningless waking-light.
sanskrit_cite: ye ye ke 'pi prakāśā mayi sati paramavyomni labdhāvakāśāḥ | kāśā hy eteṣu nitye mahimani mayi te nirvibhāgaṃ vibhānti | so 'haṃ nirvyājanityapratihatakalanānantasatyasvatantradhvastadvaitādvayāridvayamayatimirāpārabodhaprakāśaḥ

lines: Reckon, time, the measures; creator, eagerly create; churn, love, command-swayed —
play-pomp sky-homed as it were, in self-drawn line-trains, rest on body-and-all: in perverse great folly's stain, what see I not?
sanskrit_cite: kālaḥ saṅkalayan kalāḥ kalayatu sraṣṭā sṛjatv ādarād | ājñāyāḥ paratantratām upagato mathnātu vā manmathaḥ | krīḍāḍambara ambarāśrayam iva svollekharekhākramaṃ | dehādyāśrayam astu vaikṛtamahāmohe na paśyāmi kim

lines: Who here, sir, shall I swallow; who here, sir, suddenly slay;
who here, sir — frenzied-formed in supreme-waking-home-devouring — shall I drink?
sanskrit_cite: kaḥ ko 'tra bhor yaṃ kavalīkaromi | kaḥ ko 'tra bhor yaṃ sahasā nihanmi | kaḥ ko 'tra bhor yaṃ parabodhadhāmasañcarvaṇonmattatanuḥ pivāmi

lines: Becoming-born fear shattered, jackal-pack scared; on wisdom's yoke even the wise —
for once, what waking! From beyond-contentment's rise in deep-forest roaming, Rāmyadeva Hari made the non-difference-elephant trumpet.
sanskrit_cite: bhavotthabhayabhaṅgadaṅ gadaśṛgālavidrāvaṇaṃ | prabodhadhuri dhīmatām api sakṛd yad uddīpanam | sudhāma gahanāṭavīviharaṇātitṛptyudgamād | abhedakaribṛṃhitaṃ vyadhita ramyadevo hariḥ
